editorial:
You follow two men on opposite sides of the law in 1970s America. Frank Lucas is a quiet, ruthless drug lord who smuggles heroin into the country using military planes returning from Vietnam. Richie Roberts is an honest cop trying to take him down. The movie feels gritty and real, pulling you into New York and the world of organized crime. You see how power and money change people on both sides.

Denzel Washington and Russell Crowe give strong performances, and the pacing keeps you hooked from start to finish. The action is tense but never overdone. Some scenes run long, and the story can feel heavy at times. The supporting cast is solid, and the costumes and music fit the era perfectly. If you enjoy crime dramas, this one is for you. Watch it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, renting on Apple TV, or on 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: Frank Lucas gets caught after Richie Roberts builds a case against him. Frank agrees to help the police and gives up corrupt cops and other drug dealers. He gets a reduced sentence and serves time in prison. After his release, he lives a quiet life. Richie becomes a defense lawyer. The movie ends with Frank walking free, showing that even powerful criminals can fall.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime dramas and true stories.
